testAuthorityApproval.body:
Authorised Test Authority approval

Name: Ashish
GitHub account: `ashish50thbirthday-ship-it`
Role: Authorised Test Authority
Date: 16 September 2026

I approve independent testing of the remaining Phase 3 SQL Slices 2–4 on branch `feature/ph3-sql-remaining-implementation`, beginning with Slice 2 commit `32310275b9486be3a93eb3b826021958c10b1d50`.

This phase-level approval covers:

* Synthetic-data testing of Slices 2–4 within the approved architecture.
* Tester-authored and strengthened unit, integration, API, security and browser tests.
* Tenant/project isolation and ADR-008 permission testing.
* Additive migration inspection and EF model validation.
* Migration apply, rollback and reapply testing against fresh, previously nonexistent isolated local SQL Server databases.
* CSV validation, staging, reconciliation, idempotency and immutable-history assurance.
* Dependency vulnerability checks.
* Tester-only test, evidence and assurance-harness corrections.
* Repeated assurance runs where necessary, provided each run uses a fresh isolated database and retains all evidence.

This approval does not authorise production or shared database access, customer data, destructive cleanup, SQL Server security/configuration changes, deployment, merge, production migration or release.

Future Slice 3 and Slice 4 commits on this branch are covered only where they remain within the approved `PH3_SQL_Remaining_Phase_Architecture.md`. A material change to architecture, production scope, customer-data use, SQL instance, security boundaries or exclusions requires renewed approval.

Ashish
Authorised Test Authority
